deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'set -eu; found=0; for f in /backups/*.dump.fernet; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; m="$f.manifest.json"; [ -s "$f" ] && [ -s "$m" ] || continue; found=1; printf "BACKUP_ARTIFACT name=%s size_bytes=%s manifest=%s manifest_size_bytes=%s\n" "$(basename "$f")" "$(wc -c < "$f")" "$(basename "$m")" "$(wc -c < "$m")"; done; [ "$found" -eq 1 ]'
